predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: French Mauritania, independent from France on 28 November 1960; Cliopatria carries the land in its French Fifth Republic row for 1958-1960

ledger.x: 28 November 1960: Mauritania becomes independent from France.
December 1975: Mauritanian troops take Tichla and La Guera.
1976: Mauritania annexes the southern part of Western Sahara.
August 1979: Mauritania gives up Tiris al-Gharbiyya.
5 August 1979: the peace treaty ends Mauritania's war with the Polisario.

wars.name: Western Sahara War
wars.outcome: Mauritania made peace with the Polisario on 5 August 1979 and withdrew; Morocco annexed Tiris al-Gharbiyya on 11 August 1979.

wars.name: Mauritania-Senegal border conflict
wars.outcome: The page opened gives only the opening incidents; no territorial change.

certainty.note: The frontiers run through the Sahara and the Senegal valley and the pages opened give no boundary treaty or survey for any of them; the Western Sahara frontier was moved in 1976 and 1979 and is soft throughout.
